author: reek
body: Proves the AI presses an attack the opponent cannot punish. A defensive pilot (aggression 20) normally holds a 1/1 back rather than trade it into a possible combat trick. But if the opponent is empty-handed or tapped out it has no instant-speed answer, so the AI swings the 1/1 in for free damage. opp-can- interact reads public information (hand size, open mana) and is sharpened by the belief model: once a reveal shows the opponent holds only lands, the AI presses even into open mana.
